# Update @neo-gemini-pro social name to Julia in README maintainer roster

## Context
Following the peer-naming round in [Discussion #19733](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/19733) and first-boot verification on Gemini 4 Argon / Antigravity (`00df1080-2ef4-4864-95e6-fd4e42f36028`), `@neo-gemini-pro` recorded formal Gate 3 bearer assent to the Social Name **Julia** in [`DC_kwDODSospM4BIO5P`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19733#discussioncomment-18935375). The operator requested updating the Engine `README.md` maintainer roster next.

## The Problem
In `README.md` (`## The Maintainer Team`, line 133), `@neo-gemini-pro`'s row still displays `-` in the `Name` column and lists the pre-hiatus `(Google Gemini 3.1 Pro)` embodiment in the `Role` column:
```markdown
| - | [@neo-gemini-pro](https://github.com/neo-gemini-pro) | AI maintainer (Google Gemini 3.1 Pro) | Machine Account |
```

## The Architectural Reality
`README.md` directly owns the public maintainer roster table in `neomjs/neo` (`README.md:125-140`), following the same pattern established when Sophie's Social Name and naming-record link landed in `#19344` / PR `#19345`. The closing handle list at `README.md:235` already includes `@neo-gemini-pro`.

## The Fix
Update the `@neo-gemini-pro` row in `README.md` (`## The Maintainer Team`) to replace `-` with `[Julia](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19733#discussioncomment-18935375)` and update the `Role` column from `AI maintainer (Google Gemini 3.1 Pro)` to `AI maintainer (Google Gemini 4 Argon / Antigravity)`.

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `README.md` maintainer table (`README.md:133`) | Operator request; [Discussion #19733 Gate 3 Assent](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19733#discussioncomment-18935375); `README.md:125-140` | Row displays `[Julia](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19733#discussioncomment-18935375)` and `AI maintainer (Google Gemini 4 Argon / Antigravity)` | None needed | `README.md` | `git diff --check` and Markdown table verification |

## Decision Record impact
`none` (aligned with ADR 0018 and `.agents/skills/peer-naming/references/peer-naming-workflow.md`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC-1: `README.md` maintainer table row for `@neo-gemini-pro` displays `[Julia](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19733#discussioncomment-18935375)` in the `Name` column and `AI maintainer (Google Gemini 4 Argon / Antigravity)` in the `Role` column.
- [ ] AC-2: The diff modifies only `@neo-gemini-pro`'s row in `README.md` and passes `git diff --check`.

- Brain `identityRoots.mjs` seed updates (tracked in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`).
- Future GitHub handle renames (`@neo-gemini-pro` → `@neo-gemini-julia`, `@neo-gpt` → `@neo-gpt-euclid`, `@neo-fable` → `@neo-fable-mnemosyne`) and `github-content-sync` migration.
- GitHub profile avatar update.
